packageRules.description: Minor and patch package updates are batched into one branch each Monday (UTC) and merged straight into main once CI passes. A PR is opened only when CI fails. Major updates always get a PR.

Every package update also bumps the SDK minor version, so release.yml publishes it as soon as the update lands on main. This uses bumpVersions because bumpVersion is skipped for in-range updates, which only change the lockfile. Branches are rebased whenever main moves, so the bump always starts from the version that is on main.
